title: Blaizio registry item
description: One installable unit: a component, a shared helper, a theme or a font.

name.description: The slug the item is installed and tracked by, and its file name in the built output.

type.description: What the item installs. Defaults to registry:ui.

title.description: Human label for search results and listings.

version.description: The version this document describes, in the registry's own scheme. Lets consumers pin an install (blaizio add item@version) and record what landed; a registry that omits it is unversioned.

description.description: One line about the item, shown by search and view.

author.description: Who published the item, e.g. 'Jane Doe <jane@acme.dev>'. Display only.

categories.description: Free-form browse/filter tags (e.g. 'forms', 'charts'). Matched by search --category, case-insensitively.

docs.description: A short note shown to the consumer when the item installs and by docs/view - setup steps, a documentation URL, a caveat.

meta.description: Arbitrary registry-defined metadata, carried through untouched. The CLI never reads it.

nugetDependencies.description: Packages installed with 'dotnet add package' before the files land. A bare id floats to the latest version; id@version pins one.

devDependencies.description: Packages needed only at development/build time (analyzers, source generators). Installed like nugetDependencies, then marked PrivateAssets="all" in the csproj.

registryDependencies.description: Other items pulled in first, resolved transitively. A plain name comes from the same registry; @namespace/item reaches another one.

files.description: The source files the item carries. Required for every type except registry:theme and registry:font.

cssVars.description: Token overrides. The payload of a theme item; any item may carry one.

css.description: CSS blocks shipped into the consumer's tokens file, keyed by block prelude ('@keyframes spin', '@utility tab-4', '@layer components', a selector) with the block body as the value. Written inside a managed item-keyed region; remove/uninstall take it back out. Token values belong in cssVars, not here.

font.description: The font a registry:font item applies.

path.description: Path relative to the manifest. Must stay inside the manifest's folder.

type.description: The kind of source file; drives where it lands in the consumer project.

content.description: Inline file contents. Written by 'blaizio build'; absent in a manifest.

target.description: Destination override, relative to the consumer's component output folder.

cssVars.description: Token values patched into the consumer's tokens file. Names may be written with or without the -- prefix.

name.description: The catalog font name, e.g. inter.

heading.description: True to set the heading face (--font-heading); false for the body font.
